data.translation: <...> every single one of us should work hard the same way. <...>

rationale: First Infectum box evidence; modal necessity and individual striving extend the existing effort meaning without a new sense.

data.turoyo: W ḥatta l ʕmum, d kətne b briṯo du ʕamayḏan, u ahlayḏan as səryoye. Am mədhoye, d mǧahadde, kayuwwe bu medano.
data.translation: (Ich danke) unserem Volk der Suryoye, unseren Leuten, sogar überall auf der Welt und den Leuten aus Midən, für ihre Mühen und ihr Mitgefühl in dieser Angelegenheit.

rationale: Fill Preterit/1 with an explicit plural community participant in a social-support context, beyond the already quoted Europe passage.

summary: Correct sterben → streben in the etymological gloss.
rationale: In the gloss sequence sich bemühen, sterben; kämpfen, sterben (die) is an evident letter transposition for streben (strive), consistent with sich bemühen and the entry’s sense of exertion.

summary: Repair the malformed German government in the sense gloss.
before: um. jm. bemühen, für jm. kämpfen;
after: sich um jn. bemühen, für jn. kämpfen;
rationale: German requires sich um jemanden bemühen and für jemanden kämpfen. The entry has lost sich, has an intrusive period after um, and uses the dative abbreviation jm. where um and für require accusative jn.

summary: All four occurrences checked. Armed fighting, advocacy and communal effort share the existing sense; the kind of cause does not warrant new numbering.
The Infectum mǧahəd is distinct from Preterit mǧahadde in the thanks passages.
29/498 and Talay 1/368 are source duplicates of inherited material. The sense of acting on behalf of someone is retained, including the inherited qumayxu example.
